bio: Located behind the parliament building (Congreso de los Diputados), Casa Montero’s philosophy can be summed up by the phrase “There is virtue in simplicity”. In this restaurant, with its minimalist-industrial decor dominated by simple features such as ceramics and terracotta, the cuisine is full of traditional soul accompanied by the occasional dash of creativity. The concise à la carte features medias raciones, a handful of specials, as well as some superb appetisers (creamy croquettes, crispy bacon “torreznos” etc), mouthwatering stews and a selection of dishes cooked on the grill....
